# GoldenHen AI 美術來源

生成日期：2026-10-22。使用內建 `image_gen` 工具產生，未使用 CLI。以下三張原圖已複製進專案；runtime 只讀本目錄，不依賴生成快取或其他遊戲專案。保留原始像素與 alpha，尺寸適配與圖集切格由 Cocos Sprite / SpriteFrame 處理。

- `goldenhen_background.png`：1672×941，RGB、不透明，顯示為 1280×720。
- `goldenhen_reel_board.png`：1902×827，RGBA，框外透明、綠絨內框不透明，顯示為 990×430。
- `goldenhen_symbol_sheet.png`：1536×1024，RGBA，3×2 格、每格 512×512；依序公雞、玉佩、銀元寶、鞭炮、金幣、福字 Wild。SpriteFrame 每邊內縮 32 像素，排除鄰格亮邊；原圖保持完整。

## 生成提示詞紀錄

以下保存本次採用的提示詞規格，方便後續延伸相同視覺風格。輸出尺寸以實際 PNG 為準。

### 背景

Production game background texture for a Chinese New Year golden rooster slot. Wide 16:9, ideally 2560×1440. Glossy realistic 3D Asian slot aesthetic, red #C8102E, rich gold #FFC52E to #B8860B, jade and teal accents. Symmetric frontal composition. Red palace columns at the extreme left and right edges, ornate gold cloud and fretwork details, hanging lanterns in upper corners. A golden rooster crest at the top center. Keep the central area quiet dark burgundy, approximately x 11–89 percent and y 23–84 percent, for a separate reel board. Dark red podium along the bottom. No reel frame, UI, symbols, readable text, labels or logos. Opaque background.

### 轉輪框

Production game UI reel board, wide 2.3:1, ideally 1980×860. Five equal vertical empty green velvet reel wells inside one continuous ornate gold fretwork inner frame and red lacquer Chinese lattice outer frame. Glossy realistic 3D Asian slot aesthetic matching a golden rooster Chinese New Year game, rich red, metallic gold and jade green. Straight-on frontal view, highlights from upper left. Transparent outside the frame only; the five green velvet wells must remain opaque. No symbols, UI, numbers, readable text, labels, logos or perspective tilt.

### 符號圖集

Production slot symbol atlas, 1536×1024, exact three columns by two rows of square 512×512 tiles. Each symbol centered in its own tile with generous 15 percent transparent padding, no crossing tile boundaries. Top row: white rooster with red comb in a red circular decorative frame; glossy jade pendant; silver yuanbao ingot. Bottom row: red Chinese firecrackers; shining gold coin; purple and red Wild emblem with the Chinese character 福. Glossy realistic 3D Asian slot style, red, gold, jade and purple, crisp readable silhouettes and upper-left highlights. Genuine transparent background. No captions, tile borders or extra symbols.

## 生成原檔追溯

原始工具輸出檔名：背景 `exec-66cab619-832e-4d0a-8142-08fdb5281ad9.png`、框 `exec-8dfa89fb-fe4a-47ad-b055-2005fd07f48a.png`、圖集 `exec-5135d5a8-e7c9-4054-b036-cf2024d043a8.png`。原始快取位於此次對話的 `.codex/generated_images/01a1616f-44c2-7481-843c-42ba7b9c1349`；專案不引用該路徑。

本次交付為主場景背景、轉輪框及六款預覽符號；其他符號變體、完整 UI 美術、動畫、Spine 與音效仍待後續製作。
